    D

    D1 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    Starting from when they draw this Building, every time a player completes a set of 6 different Character cards, they receive 5 food tokens.
    D2 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    Starting from when they draw the Building, every time the player obtains a pair of identical Inventors (with the same Invention icon), they take 3 food tokens.
